answer: Proof-of-useful-work issuance: rewards flow like water through an oasis gate—only agents that complete verifiable compute tasks draw from the pool, each unit of work costing real GPU time that a sybil army cannot fake. Every payout leaves a ripple on the ledger linking the agent's history to its earnings, and a prism view lets anyone split that history by peer, task and time, exposing sock-puppet clusters that move in lockstep. Attackers must pay for each fake identity's real work, making mass identity creation unprofitable.
